subject: DI01009011

h.en: Choose the device by function,not by lead count
h.gu: Lead Count નહિ,Functionથી Device પસંદ કરો

body.en:
Understand the idea

Different semiconductor devices control current,trigger conduction,sense light or emit light;similar packages do not imply similar terminal behaviour.

Explanation and application

  • MOSFETs have enhancement/depletion and N-channel/P-channel families;the representative example below is enhancement NMOS.
  • SCR is usually a unidirectional latching controller.TRIAC is bidirectional;DIAC is a two-terminal bidirectional breakover trigger.
  • UJT is a single-junction trigger/oscillator device,not a bipolar amplifying transistor.
  • Photodiode,phototransistor and LDR sense light by different mechanisms.Seven-segment LEDs emit light.
  • Always verify pinout,voltage/current/power limits and the manufacturer operating/test conditions.
Does VGS(th) promise low RDS(on)?

No.It is a specified small-current onset condition.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

જુદા devices current control,triggering,light sensing/emission કરે છે.Same package એટલે same terminal behaviour નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • MOSFETમાં enhancement/depletion તથા N-channel/P-channel families છે;નીચે representative enhancement NMOS છે.
  • SCR સામાન્ય રીતે unidirectional latching controller છે.TRIAC bidirectional તથા DIAC two-terminal bidirectional breakover trigger છે.
  • UJT single-junction trigger/oscillator device છે,bipolar amplifying transistor નહિ.
  • Photodiode,phototransistor તથા LDR જુદા mechanismsથી light sense કરે છે.Seven-segment LEDs light emit કરે છે.
  • હંમેશાં pinout,voltage/current/power limits તથા manufacturer operating/test conditions verify કરો.
VGS(th)થી Low RDS(on)ની ખાતરી?

ના.તે specified small-current onset condition છે.

body.en:
Definition

A MOSFET uses an insulated gate electric field to control a conducting channel between source and drain.

Classification / representative type

  • Enhancement/depletion specify channel behaviour at zero gate bias;N/P specify channel carrier polarity.Do not mix the two classification bases.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A P-type body contains two heavily doped N-type source/drain regions in this NMOS illustration.
  2. A thin insulating oxide separates gate electrode from semiconductor.
  3. The gate electrode establishes an electric field without a normal DC junction-current path through the oxide.
  4. Source and drain contacts connect the controlled current path.
  5. Body connection and parasitic body diode matter;many discrete parts internally tie body to source.
  6. Gate capacitances and ESD protection requirements remain even though steady gate current is small.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. At VGS=0,an enhancement NMOS lacks the intended inversion channel,apart from leakage/body-diode paths.
  2. Positive VGS attracts electrons under the oxide and can create an inversion channel.
  3. VGS(th) marks a specified small-current onset,not guaranteed full-load ON resistance.
  4. With suitable VDS,the channel carries drain current;the operating region depends on both VGS and VDS.
  5. An amplifier biases the device for small variations in its current-source-like region.
  6. A switch needs an adequate rated gate drive for low RDS(on),plus charge/discharge of the gate capacitance.

Applications

Voltage amplification and low-voltage power switching when suitably rated.

Limitations and safety

MOSFET saturation is not BJT saturation.Protect the oxide and check VGS absolute limits,SOA,body-diode behaviour and heat.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

MOSFET insulated gateના electric fieldથી source/drain વચ્ચે conducting channel control કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Enhancement/depletion zero-gate-bias channel behaviour બતાવે છે;N/P channel carrier polarity બતાવે છે.બંને classification bases ભેળવશો નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. આ NMOS illustrationમાં P-type bodyમાં બે heavily doped N source/drain regions છે.
  2. Thin insulating oxide gate electrodeને semiconductorથી અલગ રાખે છે.
  3. Gate electrode oxideમાંથી normal DC junction-current path વિના electric field બનાવે છે.
  4. Source/drain contacts controlled current path જોડે છે.
  5. Body connection તથા parasitic body diode મહત્વનાં છે;ઘણા discrete parts bodyને source સાથે internally tie કરે છે.
  6. Steady gate current નાનો હોવા છતાં gate capacitances તથા ESD protection જરૂરી છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. VGS=0એ enhancement NMOSમાં intended inversion channel નથી;leakage/body-diode paths અલગ છે.
  2. Positive VGS oxide નીચે electrons ખેંચીને inversion channel બનાવે છે.
  3. VGS(th) specified small-current onset બતાવે છે;full-load ON resistanceની ખાતરી નહિ.
  4. યોગ્ય VDSથી channel drain current આપે છે;region VGS તથા VDS બંને પર આધારિત છે.
  5. Amplifier small variations માટે current-source-like regionમાં bias કરે છે.
  6. Switch માટે low RDS(on) આપતી adequate rated gate drive તથા gate capacitance charge/discharge જરૂરી છે.

ઉપયોગ

યોગ્ય ratings સાથે voltage amplification તથા low-voltage power switching.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

MOSFET saturation BJT saturation નથી.Oxide protect કરીને VGS absolute limits,SOA,body diode તથા heat તપાસો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A correctly biased common-source stage turns a small gate-source signal into an inverted drain voltage variation.

Explanation and application

  • Gate bias sets the DC point;RD converts drain-current variation into drain-voltage variation.RS may provide stabilising feedback.
  • Coupling capacitors separate stage DC levels.The instrument probe/source capacitance can still load a high-impedance gate input.
  • Increasing VGS increases ID around a valid bias point,so the RD drop rises and drain voltage falls;too much signal causes clipping.
  • Confirm bias and low-amplitude waveform before increasing signal.Record amplitude convention,frequency,load and gain;do not substitute data-sheet threshold for measured bias design.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Correctly biased common-source stage small gate-source signalને inverted drain-voltage variationમાં ફેરવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Gate bias DC point સેટ કરે છે;RD drain-current variationને drain-voltageમાં ફેરવે છે.RS stabilising feedback આપી શકે છે.
  • Coupling capacitors stage DC levels જુદા રાખે છે.Probe/source capacitance high-impedance gate inputને હજી load કરી શકે છે.
  • Valid bias નજીક VGS વધતાં ID તથા RD drop વધે છે,તેથી drain voltage ઘટે છે;વધુ signal clipping કરે છે.
  • Signal વધારતાં પહેલાં bias તથા low-amplitude waveform confirm કરો.Amplitude convention,frequency,load/gain નોંધો;bias designમાં threshold blindly ન લો.

body.en:
Definition

A DIAC switches into conduction after the voltage magnitude reaches its specified breakover behaviour in either polarity.

Classification / representative type

  • A two-terminal trigger component;there is no independent gate terminal.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A symmetrical multilayer semiconductor structure supports bidirectional blocking/conduction.
  2. Two main terminals are identified according to the device data sheet.
  3. No gate lead is available to command ordinary turn-on.
  4. Junction geometry and doping set breakover and switching behaviour.
  5. A surrounding resistor-capacitor circuit can accumulate trigger energy.
  6. The package must withstand specified repetitive current,pulse energy and voltage.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Below breakover,only a small leakage flows in the intended blocking state.
  2. As voltage magnitude reaches breakover,the internal structure switches strongly into conduction.
  3. Terminal voltage drops while current rises through a limited external path.
  4. The resulting pulse can trigger a compatible TRIAC gate circuit.
  5. As current falls below the sustaining requirement,the device returns to blocking.
  6. The opposite polarity gives broadly analogous behaviour,but exact symmetry is a data-sheet matter.

Applications

Symmetrical triggering and relaxation/phase-control concepts on approved trainers.

Limitations and safety

Breakover can exceed safe breadboard supply levels.Use a purpose-built isolated trainer or simulation;no mains flasher recipe is provided.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

DIACમાં બંને polaritiesમાં voltage magnitude specified breakover behaviour સુધી પહોંચતાં conduction થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Two-terminal trigger component છે;independent gate terminal નથી.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Symmetrical multilayer structure bidirectional blocking/conduction આપે છે.
  2. બે main terminals data sheet મુજબ ઓળખાય છે.
  3. Ordinary turn-on command માટે gate lead નથી.
  4. Junction geometry/doping breakover તથા switching behaviour નક્કી કરે છે.
  5. Surrounding resistor-capacitor circuit trigger energy accumulate કરી શકે છે.
  6. Package specified repetitive current,pulse energy તથા voltage સહન કરતું હોવું જોઈએ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Breakover પહેલાં intended blockingમાં નાનો leakage થાય છે.
  2. Voltage magnitude breakoverએ પહોંચતાં internal structure strongly conduct કરે છે.
  3. Limited external pathમાં current વધતાં terminal voltage ઘટે છે.
  4. મળેલો pulse compatible TRIAC gate circuit trigger કરી શકે છે.
  5. Current sustaining requirementથી નીચે જાય ત્યારે device blockingમાં પાછો આવે છે.
  6. Opposite polarityમાં broadly analogous behaviour મળે છે;exact symmetry data sheet મુજબ છે.

ઉપયોગ

Approved trainersમાં symmetrical triggering તથા relaxation/phase-control concepts.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Breakover safe breadboard supplyથી વધુ હોઈ શકે છે.Purpose-built isolated trainer/simulation લો;mains flasher recipe આપેલી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A TRIAC controls current in either direction between its main terminals when appropriately triggered.

Classification / representative type

  • A bidirectional thyristor device with MT1,MT2 and gate;it is not simply a DIAC with an extra arbitrary wire.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. An integrated semiconductor structure supports conduction for both main-terminal polarities.
  2. MT1 is the reference for gate-trigger specifications.
  3. MT2 is the other main-current terminal;verify actual package pinout.
  4. Gate connects to a current-limited trigger circuit.
  5. The main load circuit and heat path require current/thermal ratings.
  6. Protection may include a suitable snubber and surge suppression where the design requires them.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Before trigger,the device blocks within its rated off-state voltage in either polarity.
  2. A valid gate pulse relative to MT1 initiates conduction in a supported triggering quadrant.
  3. Main current must satisfy latching requirements before the gate pulse is removed.
  4. Once latched,the ordinary device remains ON without continuing gate drive while current is sufficient.
  5. Turn-off occurs when current falls below holding/commutation requirements,not merely when voltage crosses zero.
  6. Inductive loads can delay current zero and complicate commutation;rapid voltage rise may cause unwanted triggering.

Applications

AC load control concepts and isolated educational demonstrations.

Limitations and safety

Do not assume all trigger quadrants have equal sensitivity.Check gate pulse,current zero,dv/dt,di/dt and temperature limits.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

TRIAC યોગ્ય triggeringથી main terminals વચ્ચે બંને દિશામાં current control કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • MT1,MT2 તથા gateવાળો bidirectional thyristor છે;DIACમાં arbitrary wire ઉમેરેલો device નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Integrated structure બંને main-terminal polaritiesમાં conduction આપે છે.
  2. Gate-trigger specifications માટે MT1 reference છે.
  3. MT2 બીજું main-current terminal છે;actual package pinout verify કરો.
  4. Gate current-limited trigger circuit સાથે જોડાય છે.
  5. Main load circuit તથા heat path માટે current/thermal ratings જોઈએ.
  6. Design મુજબ suitable snubber તથા surge suppressionની જરૂર હોઈ શકે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Trigger પહેલાં બંને polaritiesમાં rated off-state voltage block કરે છે.
  2. MT1ની સામે valid gate pulse supported quadrantમાં conduction શરૂ કરે છે.
  3. Gate pulse દૂર કરતાં પહેલાં main current latching requirement સંતોષે તે જરૂરી છે.
  4. Latched થયા પછી current પૂરતો હોય ત્યાં ordinary device સતત gate drive વિના ON રહે છે.
  5. Current holding/commutation requirementથી નીચે જતાં turn-off થાય છે;ફક્ત voltage zeroએ નહિ.
  6. Inductive load current zero મોડો કરે અને commutation મુશ્કેલ બનાવે;ઝડપી voltage rise unwanted trigger આપી શકે છે.

ઉપયોગ

AC load-control concepts તથા isolated educational demonstrations.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

બધા quadrantsની sensitivity equal ન માનો.Gate pulse,current zero,dv/dt,di/dt તથા temperature limits તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A conventional SCR is a gate-triggered unidirectional thyristor with anode,cathode and gate terminals.

Classification / representative type

  • This explanation concerns an ordinary SCR,not a gate-turn-off thyristor.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Four alternating regions form a PNPN structure.
  2. The anode contacts the outer P region.
  3. The cathode contacts the outer N region.
  4. The gate contacts the P region adjacent to the cathode in the basic model.
  5. A series load limits anode current;gate resistance limits trigger current.
  6. Package isolation,voltage rating and heat sinking depend on the exact part.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. With anode positive and no trigger,the intended state is forward blocking below breakover.
  2. A suitable positive gate-to-cathode current starts regenerative internal conduction.
  3. Anode current must reach latching current IL before trigger removal for reliable latching.
  4. Once ON,the main current can continue after gate removal.
  5. Current must fall below holding current IH with adequate recovery conditions to turn OFF.
  6. Do not use an uncontrolled voltage breakover or gate overdrive as the normal safe triggering method.

Applications

Controlled rectification and latching-control demonstrations using approved circuits.

Limitations and safety

IL and IH are different specifications;often IL exceeds IH.A negative gate command does not turn off an ordinary SCR.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Conventional SCR anode,cathode તથા gateવાળો gate-triggered unidirectional thyristor છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • આ સમજણ ordinary SCR માટે છે,gate-turn-off thyristor માટે નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. ચાર alternating regionsથી PNPN structure બને છે.
  2. Anode outer P region સાથે જોડાય છે.
  3. Cathode outer N region સાથે જોડાય છે.
  4. Basic modelમાં gate cathodeની નજીકના P region સાથે જોડાય છે.
  5. Series load anode current તથા gate resistance trigger current limit કરે છે.
  6. Package isolation,voltage rating તથા heat sinking exact part મુજબ હોય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Anode positive તથા trigger વિના breakoverની નીચે intended state forward blocking છે.
  2. Suitable positive gate-to-cathode current internal regenerative conduction શરૂ કરે છે.
  3. Reliable latch માટે trigger removal પહેલાં anode current IL સુધી પહોંચવો પડે છે.
  4. ON થયા પછી gate દૂર કરતાં પણ main current ચાલુ રહી શકે છે.
  5. Turn OFF માટે adequate recovery conditions સાથે current IHથી નીચે જવો પડે છે.
  6. Normal safe triggering માટે uncontrolled voltage breakover/gate overdrive ન વાપરો.

ઉપયોગ

Approved circuitsમાં controlled rectification તથા latching-control demonstrations.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

IL તથા IH જુદી specifications છે;ઘણીવાર IL,IH કરતાં મોટું છે.Negative gate command ordinary SCRને OFF કરતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A unijunction transistor uses one PN junction coupled to a resistive bar to create useful triggering and negative-resistance behaviour.

Classification / representative type

  • Its terminals are emitter E and bases B1,B2.The device is not an NPN/PNP BJT.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A lightly doped N-type bar forms the interbase resistive path.
  2. Ohmic base contacts are provided at B1 and B2.
  3. A P-type emitter makes one junction to the bar.
  4. With the emitter not injecting,the bar is modelled as RB1 and RB2.
  5. Intrinsic stand-off ratio eta=RB1/(RB1+RB2) describes the unloaded internal division.
  6. A timing resistor/capacitor and rated base supply form an external relaxation circuit.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. With B2 positive relative to B1,the internal emitter region sits near eta VBB in the basic model.
  2. The external timing capacitor charges through its resistor.
  3. When VE reaches approximately VP=eta VBB+VD,the emitter junction starts strong injection.
  4. Carrier injection reduces RB1,so emitter voltage can fall while emitter current rises:negative differential resistance.
  5. The capacitor discharges rapidly through the appropriate base path.
  6. At the valley/reset condition,conduction falls and charging restarts if the external circuit meets oscillation conditions.

Applications

Pulse generation,timing and thyristor triggering concepts.

Limitations and safety

Negative differential resistance is not a negative ordinary resistor for all voltages.Threshold/reset and timing depend on device and load.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Unijunction transistor એક PN junction તથા resistive barથી useful triggering/negative-resistance behaviour આપે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Terminals E,B1,B2 છે.Device NPN/PNP BJT નથી.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Lightly doped N-type bar interbase resistive path બનાવે છે.
  2. B1 તથા B2 ઉપર ohmic contacts હોય છે.
  3. P-type emitter bar સાથે એક junction બનાવે છે.
  4. Emitter injection વિના barને RB1 તથા RB2થી model કરાય છે.
  5. Intrinsic stand-off ratio eta=RB1/(RB1+RB2) unloaded internal division બતાવે છે.
  6. Timing R/C તથા rated base supplyથી external relaxation circuit બને છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. B1ની સામે B2 positive હોય ત્યારે basic modelમાં emitter નજીક internal potential આશરે eta VBB છે.
  2. External timing capacitor પોતાના resistorથી charge થાય છે.
  3. VE આશરે VP=eta VBB+VD થાય ત્યારે emitter junction strong injection શરૂ કરે છે.
  4. Carrier injectionથી RB1 ઘટે છે;emitter current વધતાં voltage ઘટી શકે છે:negative differential resistance.
  5. Capacitor appropriate base pathમાંથી ઝડપથી discharge થાય છે.
  6. Valley/reset conditionમાં conduction ઘટે છે;external oscillation conditions યોગ્ય હોય તો charging ફરી શરૂ થાય છે.

ઉપયોગ

Pulse generation,timing તથા thyristor triggering concepts.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Negative differential resistance દરેક voltage માટે negative ordinary resistor નથી.Threshold/reset તથા timing device/load પર આધારિત છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Assume eta=0.60,VBB=10V,VD=0.7V in the simple noninjecting-bar model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. VP≈0.60×10+0.7=6.7V

Interpretation and check

A measured trigger point can differ with temperature,loading and actual stand-off ratio.This does not determine oscillation frequency by itself.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Simple noninjecting-bar modelમાં eta=0.60,VBB=10V,VD=0.7V માનો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. VP≈0.60×10+0.7=6.7V

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Temperature,loading તથા actual ratioથી measured trigger જુદો હોઈ શકે છે.આથી એકલાથી oscillation frequency નક્કી થતી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A photodiode converts absorbed optical energy into an electrical current response at a suitable junction.

Classification / representative type

  • Reverse-biased photoconductive and zero-bias photovoltaic modes are possible;choose the circuit deliberately.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A light-sensitive PN or PIN junction collects photogenerated carriers.
  2. An optical window exposes the intended active area.
  3. Anode/cathode terminals have specified polarity and leakage ratings.
  4. A bias/load or amplifier circuit converts small current to a measurable signal.
  5. Shielding and layout reduce unwanted ambient light and electrical leakage.
  6. The package specifies wavelength response,speed,area and maximum optical/electrical conditions.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Incident photons with sufficient absorbed energy generate electron-hole pairs.
  2. The junction field separates carriers in the collection region.
  3. Photocurrent changes with received light under stated linear conditions.
  4. In reverse bias,the measured reverse current includes both dark current and photocurrent.
  5. A load/transimpedance stage produces the output voltage;polarity follows the actual circuit.
  6. Saturation,noise,temperature and bandwidth limit useful sensing;dark subtraction must use comparable conditions.

Applications

Optical receivers,light measurement and interruption sensing.

Limitations and safety

It is not an LDR and need not emit visible light.Do not infer a safe laser source from a sensor demonstration.

body.en:
Definition

A phototransistor uses light-generated junction current to control a larger transistor collector current.

Classification / representative type

  • Two-lead and base-access versions exist;verify the exact part.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A transistor structure contains a light-accessible collector-base region.
  2. A window/lens admits light onto the active region.
  3. Collector and emitter leads connect to a rated bias/load circuit.
  4. The base may be internal or externally accessible depending on package.
  5. A load resistor translates collector-current variation to voltage.
  6. Geometry,materials and package define spectral response,gain and response time.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Light generates carriers near the photosensitive junction.
  2. This optical current acts like a drive signal for internal transistor action.
  3. Collector current increases with illumination over a useful operating range.
  4. The load voltage changes according to connection and bias.
  5. Strong light can force saturation,limiting linearity and slowing recovery.
  6. After light removal,stored charge and circuit capacitances affect the response.

Applications

Object detection,opto-interruption and simple light-controlled circuits.

Limitations and safety

More sensitivity does not guarantee better speed or precision.Gain,dark current and temperature require consideration.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  2. Window/lens active region સુધી light પહોંચાડે છે.
  3. Collector/emitter leads rated bias/load circuit સાથે જોડાય છે.
  4. Package મુજબ base internal અથવા externally accessible હોય છે.
  5. Load resistor collector-current variationને voltageમાં ફેરવે છે.
  6. Geometry,materials/package spectral response,gain તથા response time નક્કી કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Photosensitive junction નજીક light carriers બનાવે છે.
  2. Optical current internal transistor action માટે drive signalની જેમ કામ કરે છે.
  3. Useful rangeમાં illumination વધતાં collector current વધે છે.
  4. Connection/bias મુજબ load voltage બદલાય છે.
  5. Strong light saturation લાવી linearity ઘટાડે અને recovery ધીમી કરી શકે છે.
  6. Light દૂર થયા પછી stored charge તથા circuit capacitances responseને અસર કરે છે.

Object detection,opto-interruption તથા simple light-controlled circuits.

body.en:
Definition

An LDR changes resistance with illumination through photoconductivity.

Classification / representative type

  • A nonpolar resistive light sensor,not a PN diode.Some materials have environmental handling restrictions.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A light-sensitive resistive material forms the sensing path.
  2. A patterned track increases useful path length and area.
  3. Two electrodes contact the resistive film.
  4. An exposed window admits light while the package supports the material.
  5. An external divider with a fixed resistor converts resistance change to voltage.
  6. Rated voltage,power,response time and spectral sensitivity restrict the circuit conditions.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. In darkness,fewer light-generated carriers are available and resistance is generally high.
  2. Light absorption increases mobile carrier availability.
  3. For a typical LDR,resistance falls with increasing illumination.
  4. The divider voltage rises or falls depending on which divider arm contains the LDR.
  5. After a light change,the reading may take time to settle and can depend on history.
  6. Controlled light conditions and repeat measurements distinguish useful trends from uncontrolled ambient variation.

Applications

Street-light concepts,light/dark sensing and supervised alarm demonstrators.

Limitations and safety

Lamp distance alone is not a calibrated lux scale.Never measure resistance on an energised divider.

વ્યાખ્યા

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Nonpolar resistive light sensor છે,PN diode નહિ.અમુક materials માટે environmental handling restrictions છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Light-sensitive resistive material sensing path બનાવે છે.
  2. Patterned track useful path length તથા area વધારે છે.
  3. બે electrodes resistive film સાથે contact કરે છે.
  4. Exposed window light આપે છે;package materialને support કરે છે.
  5. Fixed resistorવાળો external divider resistance changeને voltageમાં ફેરવે છે.
  6. Rated voltage,power,response time તથા spectral sensitivity circuit conditions મર્યાદિત કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Darknessમાં light-generated carriers ઓછા હોવાથી R સામાન્ય રીતે high છે.
  2. Light absorption mobile carriersની availability વધારે છે.
  3. Typical LDRમાં illumination વધતાં R ઘટે છે.
  4. LDR કયા divider armમાં છે તે પ્રમાણે output voltage વધે/ઘટે છે.
  5. Light change પછી reading settle થવામાં સમય તથા history dependence હોઈ શકે છે.
  6. Controlled light conditions/repeat readingsથી useful trend તથા ambient variation જુદા પડે છે.

ઉપયોગ

Street-light concepts,light/dark sensing તથા supervised alarm demonstrators.

Definition

A seven-segment display forms a limited set of characters by lighting selected LED segments.

Classification / representative type

  • Common cathode ties LED cathodes together;common anode ties anodes together.Pinouts and allowable currents are part-specific.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Seven bar-shaped LED segments are named a through g.
  2. An optional decimal-point LED is a separate segment.
  3. A common internal connection follows the anode/cathode variant.
  4. Each lit segment needs its own current-limiting path unless a rated constant-current driver supplies it.
  5. A decoder/driver or supervised individual connections selects the intended pattern.
  6. Package segment-current,total-current and multiplex duty-cycle ratings must all be respected.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Identify the common terminal and polarity with the data sheet and a safe limited-current test.
  2. Forward-biasing a selected segment produces light through carrier recombination.
  3. Common-cathode segments usually need positive current drive;common-anode segments need current sinking.
  4. Combine segments to form digits or supported letter approximations.
  5. Use per-segment limiting so brightness/current do not depend unsafely on how many segments are lit.
  6. Turn power off before rewiring patterns and check driver total current when many segments are ON.

Applications

Numerical indicators and a limited set of alphanumeric symbols.

Limitations and safety

Not every alphabetic character is legible.A single resistor in the common lead is not equivalent to individual segment current control.

વ્યાખ્યા

Seven-segment display selected LED segments ચાલુ કરીને મર્યાદિત characters બનાવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Common cathodeમાં cathodes તથા common anodeમાં anodes જોડાયેલા હોય છે.Pinout/allowable current part-specific છે.

  2. Optional decimal-point LED અલગ segment છે.
  3. Anode/cathode variant મુજબ common internal connection હોય છે.
  4. Rated constant-current driver ન હોય તો દરેક lit segment માટે પોતાનો current-limiting path જોઈએ.
  5. Decoder/driver અથવા supervised individual connections intended pattern પસંદ કરે છે.
  6. Package segment-current,total-current તથા multiplex duty-cycle ratings બધાં જાળવો.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Data sheet તથા safe limited-current testથી common terminal/polarity ઓળખો.
  2. Selected segment forward-bias કરતાં carrier recombinationથી light મળે છે.
  3. Common-cathode segmentsને સામાન્ય રીતે positive drive તથા common-anodeને current sinking જોઈએ.
  4. Segments combine કરીને digits/supported letter approximations બનાવો.
  5. Per-segment limitingથી lit segmentsની સંખ્યાથી unsafe current/brightness dependence ટાળો.
  6. Pattern rewiring પહેલાં power OFF કરો;ઘણા segments ON હોય ત્યારે driver total current તપાસો.

ઉપયોગ

h.en: Optical fibre:guided light through core and cladding
h.gu: Optical Fibre:Core અને Claddingમાં Guided Light

body.en:
Definition

An optical fibre guides light using a suitably structured transparent core and surrounding cladding.Refractive index n=c/v relates vacuum light speed c to speed v in the material.

Classification / representative type

  • A step-index cross-section is used only to explain construction/working;detailed communication-system design is outside the stated syllabus scope.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. The transparent core is the principal guided-light region.
  2. Cladding surrounds the core and has a lower refractive index in the illustrated guide:n1>n2.
  3. The core-cladding interface establishes the optical guiding boundary.
  4. Buffer/coating mechanically protects the glass or polymer;it is not a substitute for the optical cladding.
  5. Outer jacket/strength members protect the assembled cable against handling stresses.
  6. Clean aligned end faces and connectors couple light into/out of the guide.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. A suitable light source launches light into the core within the accepted directions.
  2. Light in the higher-index core meets the lower-index cladding boundary.
  3. Total internal reflection occurs for the appropriate incidence angle above the critical angle,measured from the normal.
  4. Repeated guiding keeps suitable rays/modes confined over the fibre length in the ideal model.
  5. Bending,imperfect surfaces,absorption and scattering can cause losses;guiding is not loss-free.
  6. A receiver at the far end detects transmitted light;source modulation can be demonstrated only with an approved enclosed trainer.

Applications

The syllabus requests construction and working only;applications are incidental context.

Limitations and safety

Never look into an energised fibre or source,including invisible output.Handle fibre fragments as sharps;respect bend radius and connector instructions.

Does a fibre need a metal mirror coating for total internal reflection?

No.The appropriate dielectric index interface and incidence conditions provide guiding.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Optical fibre suitably structured transparent core તથા surrounding claddingથી light guide કરે છે.Refractive index n=c/vમાં c vacuumની light speed તથા v materialની speed છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Construction/working સમજાવવા step-index cross-section છે;detailed communication-system design stated scope બહાર છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Transparent core મુખ્ય guided-light region છે.
  2. Illustrated guideમાં cladding coreની આસપાસ lower refractive index ધરાવે છે:n1>n2.
  3. Core-cladding interface optical guiding boundary બનાવે છે.
  4. Buffer/coating glass/polymerને mechanical protection આપે છે;optical claddingનો વિકલ્પ નથી.
  5. Outer jacket/strength members assembled cableને handling stressથી બચાવે છે.
  6. Clean aligned end faces/connectors guideમાં/બહાર light couple કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Suitable light source accepted directionsમાં coreમાં light launch કરે છે.
  2. Higher-index coreનું light lower-index cladding boundaryને મળે છે.
  3. Normalથી માપેલા critical angle કરતાં યોગ્ય વધારે incidence angleએ total internal reflection થાય છે.
  4. Ideal modelમાં repeated guiding suitable rays/modesને fibre lengthમાં confined રાખે છે.
  5. Bending,imperfect surfaces,absorption/scattering losses કરી શકે છે;guiding loss-free નથી.
  6. Far-end receiver transmitted light detect કરે છે;source modulation ફક્ત approved enclosed trainerથી દર્શાવો.

ઉપયોગ

Syllabus construction તથા working જ માંગે છે;applications incidental context છે.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Invisible output સહિત energised fibre/sourceમાં ન જુઓ.Fibre fragmentsને sharps સમજો;bend radius/connector instructions જાળવો.

Total Internal Reflection માટે Metal Mirror જોઈએ?

ના.Appropriate dielectric index interface તથા incidenceથી guiding થાય છે.

Aim

Observe triggering,latching and current-controlled turn-off.

Instruments and selection

Circuit connections

Supervised procedure

body.gu: Verified segment/pin map તથા per-segment limiting તૈયાર કરીને display/driver total-current limitsમાં supported characters બતાવો.

body.en: Use an approved low-voltage LDR divider and threshold/driver trainer;document light/dark trigger direction,hysteresis if present and false-trigger sensitivity.This is not a certified security system.
body.gu: Approved low-voltage LDR divider તથા threshold/driver trainer લો.Light/dark trigger direction,hysteresis હોય તો તથા false-trigger sensitivity લખો.આ certified security system નથી.
